## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- The proof of \(A_+=(\bar h_1,\ldots,\bar h_5)\) is adequate.
- The artifact only constructs matrices in degrees \(4,\ldots,30\). However, the complete indexed row set
  \[
  R_d=\{(t,\lambda):1\le t\le5,\ 22\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^6,\ |\lambda|=d-t\}
  \]
  remains nonempty for \(31\le d\le35\): it contains \((d-30,5^6)\). These rows are zero, since their target degree exceeds \(|5^6|=30\), but they are not rows of the recorded artifact. Thus the claimed equality of complete indexed row sets “in every degree” is not established.
- The assertion that \(J\) is an ideal should be made basiswise: if \(c_{\lambda,\mu}^{\nu}\ne0\), then \(\lambda\subseteq\nu\); hence \(\lambda\supseteq22\) implies \(\nu\supseteq22\).

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Extend the same complete-row construction through degrees \(31,\ldots,35\), preserving every indexed zero row \(h_t\bar s_\lambda\), and persist the resulting row labels and matrices; then identify those rows with the degreewise generators of \((A_+J)_d\).
